title: Null on every vanishing relatively compact open set implies null off the support
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every current T ∈ D_n(U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), every set M ⊆ ℝ^P with M ⊆ U and every measure μ on ℝ^P: if μ(M ∩ W) = 0 for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P such that closure W is compact, closure W ⊆ U and T vanishes on W (T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W), then μ(M ∖ spt T) = 0. Here spt T = T.support = U ∖ Z_T, where the zero region Z_T = T.zeroRegion is the union of all such sets W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), M ⊆ U → (∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → μ (M ∩ W) = 0) → μ (M \ T.support) = 0
